plan.rationale: A general construction and handyman business needs a straightforward, trustworthy, tool-in-hand feel rather than something soft or clinical. Bold industrial with a condensed heading font reads as sturdy and no-nonsense, matching steel and amber tones the owner already uses. I kept only claims actually stated: broad service categories, the Pretoria area list, and the no-unfinished-jobs stance. I dropped every invented number, guarantee wording and award since none of those can be verified from what was given, only the general service scope and area could be used honestly.

We show up, we do the work, and we do it right.

items.question: What areas do you cover?
items.answer: We serve Pretoria and surrounding areas including Centurion, Midrand, Hatfield, Menlyn, Lynnwood and Garsfontein. If you're nearby and unsure, just ask.

items.question: What kind of jobs can you help with?
items.answer: General home repairs, property maintenance, home improvement projects, installations and fittings, minor renovations and small building jobs. If your job doesn't fit neatly into one of these, get in touch and ask.

items.question: Do you take on small jobs as well as bigger projects?
items.answer: Yes. Whether it's a quick fix or a larger project, every job gets the same attention through to completion.
